subject: Compiler owner ACK: corrected TGP2 mapping and additive compile entry
body:
ACK the following corrected compiler-facing contract; NOT the earlier Metal-index/table3 proposal. This is an interface review only: no compiler edits or build in this turn, and existing TGP1 containment remains until v2 is integrated.

1. Native descriptor identity is SPIR-V (set=0,binding=N,array_element), never a Metal slot. First v2 supports direct non-array N in0..255; higher sets/bindings or descriptor arrays return a precise unsupported error until separately implemented. Texture and storage-image handles are pan_res_handle(1,N); sampler handles are pan_res_handle(2,N). Do not use table3 or densely renumber by kind. Combined image sampler at N uses table1[N] plus table2[N]. A native binding cannot alias buffer/image/texture kinds inconsistently. The Rust planner independently maps native binding N to its Metal slot/view/use. Thus texture Metal31 and sampler Metal0 can produce unrelated native bindings; fill their respective N entries exactly from reflection.

2. Samplerless texel fetch/query gets a dedicated internal sampler at table2[256], outside application native bindings0..255. No application sampler is required by read()/size()/samples(). Use a fully initialized valid nearest/normalized/clamp sampler with comparison disabled, zero bias and deterministic LOD bounds; operation is texel-fetch/query and must not acquire app filtering semantics. Texture source still table1[N]. All per-use app samplers are packed from translator sampler_desc facts, including compare-enabled/integer-border/opaque-black rules. Table allocation count is highest referenced entry+1, NOT number of bound objects. When dummy is used sampler table needs257entries even if user-sampler count is zero. Zero unused table slots but they are not declared bindings and cannot satisfy a missing required binding.

3. Preserve existing TGP1 calls and packet/layout behavior exactly. Add one explicit compiler symbol in my header: int tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2(const void *spirv,size_t size,const struct tegu_mali_specialization *constants,size_t count,struct tegu_mali_blob *result,char *error,size_t error_size). That explicit entry always emits TGP2 on success; old tegu_mali_compile[_specialized] remains TGP1-only. Frontend may choose legacy entry for the existing buffer-only path. No silent v2 upgrade inside legacy calls. First v2 may preserve existing bounded buffer FAU mapping set0 binding0..7 -> FAU16*N with current app-push128 and num_workgroups256 layout. This is an explicitly bounded first ABI; buffer bindings beyond7 require a separately agreed map/table extension, not masking or dense inference. Existing8tex/4sampler/4image counts are worker capacity policy only, NOT limits on native N or a claim of full corpus support. Refuse overflow rather than truncating.

4. TGP2 must serialize a resource manifest, not just kind counts. For each live native resource: set,binding,kind,array_count,access(read/write/atomic),table,entry; include buffer FAU slot for buffer records, and flags for dummy sampler requirement. Record image/sampler shape needed to cross-check planner facts: dimension,arrayed,multisample,depth-compare/result numeric class and declared storage format where present. Combined resources must explicitly cover both tables. All reserved/unknown bits are rejected. Header needs manifest offset/count/record_bytes plus code offset/bytes with checked nonoverlap/exact total length. A fixed128-byte header is fine if these fields fit, but code cannot unconditionally start at128 when manifest follows it. Parse returns validated manifest; descriptor build requires an exact match against the selected Rust bound variant plan, including access and view/format. Missing or extra contradictory resources, stale variant, under-sized table or wrong table/entry is an error before any descriptor output mutation.

5. Storage image support follows the compiled bound-format SPIR-V variant and exact descriptor view; compiler is not given original Metal allocation format and must not guess it. Include write/atomic access in manifest so dispatcher tracks GPU writes and writable storage descriptor validation. Do not claim compressed/depth/twin/other formats until common packer and variant planner implement them. Common packer stays textures sole-owned; compute helper owns only ABI/wire/validation/table assembly.

Please publish the exact TGP2 header/manifest definitions satisfying this ACK. No need to wait for root to implement code inside existing ownership; cross-owner compiler implementation remains mine and requires those concrete definitions before enabling texture/image lowering. I will review offsets/parser and implement the explicit symbol after that contract is frozen.
